ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and period ended September 30, 2026.

Press Release — Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 27, 2026, titled "MIDHANI signs MoU with HWB and BARC for recovery of Nickel and Cobalt from plant reverts".
Change in Management — Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited has informed the Exchange about re-appointment of Statutory Auditors for FY 2026-27.
General Updates — Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited has informed the Exchange about Fine imposed by BSE and National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) on MIDHANI
Outcome of Board Meeting — Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended June 30, 2026.
Copy of Newspaper Publication — Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for extract of Financial Results - FY 2025-26.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.

Dividend — Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on May 29, 2026, recommended Final Dividend of Rs. 1.25 per equity share.Also approved Audited Financial Results for Q4 and FY 2025-26.

Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations — Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
